description: §22 E-META-EVAL-001 — a `^{}` block containing the `emit(...)` compile-time API pattern (which classifies the block as compile-time meta, §22.4) whose body THROWS when evaluated: `n.toFixed(-1)` raises a RangeError (the digits argument must be 0..100) before `emit` is invoked, so meta-eval.ts catches it and fires E-META-EVAL-001 (compile-time meta evaluation failed). S457: the body is scrml-native — the former `JSON.parse("{")` reproducer named the JS-host `JSON` global, which the §22.12 closed allow-list refuses (E-META-001) before evaluation.
